Record Class ModelOptions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.clafer.frontend.ModelOptions
Record Components:
core - --core
traceLength - --tl
minInt - --minint
maxInt - --maxint
decimalDigits - --decimal-digits
simpleScopes - --ss=simple, the default, rather than --ss=none
imports - the files of --import, as written
others - the names of the other options given, e.g., -k
public record ModelOptions(boolean core, OptionalInt traceLength, OptionalLong minInt, OptionalLong maxInt, Optional<Integer> decimalDigits, boolean simpleScopes, List<String> imports, Set<String> others) extends Record
The options of a model file that the frontend uses, from its first line, //# OPTIONS ..., as the compiler reads them (Import.fileOptions): --core, --tl, --minint, --maxint, --decimal-digits, --ss and --import. An option is --name=value or --name value; the other options are kept by name only, the short name if it has one, e.g., -c for --check-duplicates, for the checks of the model and of combine(List, List, String, ModelOptions, List). As in the compiler, --explicit implies -f, -l and --ss=none.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
